Name: Quinn's Wigs - 10 New Hairstyles For Farmers
Author: jakkpays
Description:
[center][size=5][u][font=Georgia]⋆｡°✩ [b]Quinn's Wigs [/b] [/font][u][font=Georgia]✩[/font][u][font=Georgia]° [/font][u][font=Georgia]｡[u]⋆[/u][/font] [/u][/u][/u][/u][/size][/center]

[center]'Quinn's Wigs' is a Content Patcher mod that adds 10 new hairstyles to the game! These hairstyles are all new, and DO NOT replace any of the game files.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=4]You can equip them when creating your farmer for the first time or, if you want to use them in an older save file, you can also equip them at the Wizard's Tower using the Shrine of Illusions![/size][/b]

[img]https://file.garden/ajgHt0Qtw2Pbq_e0/hairstyle%20turnarounds[/img]
[left][center][b][size=5][u][font=Georgia] [u]⋆｡°✩[/u] Features[u] [u]✩[u]° [u]｡[u]⋆[/u][/u][/u][/u][/u][/font] [/u][/size][/b][/center]

This mod features ten new hairstyles, adapted from my other mod, '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30181]Jakk's Quinn - A New Romanceable NPC[/url]'! These hairstyles include:

1- [b]Spring[/b]: a mid-lenght to long, loose hairstyle
2- [b]Summer[/b]: a longer, loose and princess-ey hairstyle
3- [b]Fall[/b]: a short, boyish cut
4- [b]Winter[/b]: a shoulder-lengh style
5- [b]Flower dance[/b]: cute, high pigtails
6- [b]Bun[/b]: the hairbun Quinn uses in her 10 hearts event

[b]VARIATIONS -[/b] these can be equipped on their own OR they'll will replace their equivalent hairstyles when a hat is equipped!
7- [b]Spring[/b], but [b]ponytail[/b]: a mid-lengh ponytail like the one Quinn wears at Joja during spring
8- [b]Summer[/b], but [b]ponytail[/b]: a long ponytail with longer bangs like the one Quinn wears at Joja during summer
9- [b]Winter[/b], but [b]ponytail[/b]: a short ponytail with shorter bangs like the one Quinn wears at Joja during winter
9- [b]Bun[/b], but [b]no bun?[/b]: a very short and neat hairstyle, with an asymetrical swooping bang!

[center][b][u][size=5][font=Georgia][u]⋆｡°✩[/u] Choose how hair interacts with hats [u][u]✩[u]° [u]｡[u]⋆[/u][/u][/u][/u][/u][/font][/size][/u][/b][/center]
[/left]
[/center]

You can configure which hairstyles will be affected by hats independently!

[center][b][u][size=5][font=Georgia][u]⋆｡°✩[/u] Chose a new style or stay true to Quinn [/font][/size][u][u][size=5][font=Georgia]✩[/font][/size][u][size=5][font=Georgia]° [/font][/size][u][size=5][font=Georgia]｡[/font][/size][u][size=5][font=Georgia]⋆[/font][/size][/u][/u][/u][/u][/u][/u][/b][/center]

Hairstyles have been adapted to better suit the farmer sprites, but you can choose to keep the original styles if you'd like!

[img]https://file.garden/ajgHt0Qtw2Pbq_e0/hair%20comparison[/img]

[center][b][u][size=5][font=Georgia][u]>>[/u] Installation <<[/font][/size][/u][/b][/center]

      - Download and install [b]SMAPI[/b];
      - Download [b]Content Patcher[/b] and drop it into the 'StardewValley/Mods';
      - Download the latest mod file from the official mod page at nexus.com;
      - Drop the folder '[CP] Quinn's Wigs' into the 'StardewValley/Mods' folder;
      - You're good to go!

[center][b][u][size=5][font=Georgia][u]>>[/u] Compatibility <<[/font][/size][/u][/b] [/center]

This mod should be compatible with most, if not all, other mods! However, having over ~336 different hairstyles added to the game may lead to conflicts! Those conflicts can be resovled by installing SpaceCore, but SpaceCore is NOT necessary unless you go over that number!

[center][b][u][size=5][font=Times New Roman][u]>>[/u] Translations <<[/font][/size][/u][/b] [/center]

At the time of release, only the Portuguese translation is available. 

[center][b]PTBR: [/b]Feita e mantida por mim, a autora do mod. A tradução está disponível como um arquivo opcional para download. Para instalar, faça o download dos arquivos. Você encontrará um arquivo chamado 'pt.json', que deve ser transferido para a pasta '[CP] Quinn's Wigs/i18n' dentro da sua pasta de mods. Me avise se tiver alguma dúvida! Estou à disposição para ajudar.[/center]
[center]
[/center]
If you'd like to translate the mod, please reach out beforehand!
